parameters.description: Exactly 1. Required with a web cookie and always for web login; not required for Bearer-only mobile requests.

401.description: Invalid/expired/revoked session or credentials, or mixed cookie and Authorization. Rejected web cookies are deleted.

403.description: Insufficient access, or missing/invalid Origin or X-Shelf-CSRF on a web unsafe request.

post.description: Cookie and Authorization together are rejected (401); no credential fallback. Rejected cookies are cleared on 401. Cookies renew only after successful authenticated activity. Web requests (cookie present, and always web login) require exact configured Origin and X-Shelf-CSRF: 1, otherwise 403. No permissive API CORS.
